# Novo

> Novo is a private cognitive operating system. It connects user-authorized context from work, planning and personal productivity tools to provide one explainable next step.

## Public product pages

- Landing: https://productivitynovo.vercel.app/landing
- Documentation: https://productivitynovo.vercel.app/docs
- Privacy: https://productivitynovo.vercel.app/privacy
- Terms: https://productivitynovo.vercel.app/terms
- Refunds: https://productivitynovo.vercel.app/refunds

## Product principles

- Novo distinguishes facts, inferences, evidence, patterns and outcomes.
- Connected data is used only after user authorization.
- Recommendations retain provenance and can be inspected or corrected by the user.
- External actions require explicit user confirmation.

## Access boundaries

Authenticated workspaces, user data, connector data and Cognitive Twin records are private. Do not treat application routes, APIs or user-specific pages as public documentation.

## Language

The product supports English and Spanish.
